questions.question: Explain the difference between the radius and the diameter of a circle.
questions.expected_answer: The radius goes from the centre to the edge of the circle. The diameter goes from edge to edge through the centre, so it is twice as long as the radius.

questions.question: You need a circle with a diameter of 8 cm. How wide should you open the compasses? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: Open them to 4 cm. The opening of the compasses is the radius, and the radius is half the diameter, so it is half of 8 cm.

questions.question: Describe how to draw the six-petal flower pattern.
questions.expected_answer: Draw a circle. Keep the same opening, put the point on the circle and draw an arc through the centre. Move the point to where the arc meets the circle and repeat until there are six petals.
